body_html:
Look at these effect sizes! We know motivation matters.

 

I worry the homeowork lgs take these results, and ruin them once scaled. I have had many a fights to hit a twenty minute quota...

 

...then I think abotu how little my son see's me read for pleasure. So much of that is now on @audible with 2 hours of commuting each day.

 

I want to do a study comparing twenty minute reading logs and a nother progrema where parentsa must get caught reading for twenty minutes.
